findings.criterion: docs/user-guide.md documents selecting the DC backend and installing the extra, and the documented commands have been executed against the J5 harness
findings.detail: The documentation half is satisfied (user-guide.md:325-385 documents backend selection, extra install, least-privilege, allow_insecure, ca_bundle, resolved_statuses). The execution half is NOT met. The test file tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_user_guide_commands.py exists and is designed to execute the documented commands against the harness, but the criterion requires that those commands HAVE BEEN executed — actual execution against the J5 harness. The ticket's own last comment explicitly states: 'The criterion is satisfied when the `jira DC harness smoke` job runs this module green — that job is the only place the documented commands CAN be executed, since the harness base image is linux/amd64 only and this workstation is Apple Silicon. I will record the job result here before closing, and I will read the JOB, not the overall run status.' No job result is recorded in the ticket; the ticket status remains in_progress. The test file is concrete and not a stub, but the actual execution against the harness has not been demonstrated in the repository or the ticket.
findings.remediation: Run the `jira-dc-harness` CI job (native x86_64) with the test_user_guide_commands.py module and record the job result (job URL/id, pass/fail, and timestamp) as a ticket comment before closing.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: for each one, decide whether the work is genuinely incomplete or simply undocumented. If a requirement is already satisfied but the proof is not discoverable from the code alone, add a comment to this ticket that documents the evidence — cite the concrete artifacts that meet the requirement (file paths and line ranges, commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the work to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. For any criterion whose work is genuinely unfinished, complete it, then re-verify.
